name: Active Amount Range 3 Choice
definition: Choice between a range of amount values with or without the currency.

ImpliedCurrencyAndAmountRange.name: Implied Currency And Amount Range
ImpliedCurrencyAndAmountRange.definition: Expresses an amount or an amount range with an explicit debit/credit indicator and where the currency is implied.

CurrencyAndAmountRange.name: Currency And Amount Range
CurrencyAndAmountRange.definition: Expresses an amount or an amount range with the currency and where the credit/debit indicator is explicit.
